tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search Track & Blade used-equipment listings. Filters: class, make, model, year/price/hours min and max, free-text query. Limit defaults to 10 and caps at 25.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get one Track & Blade listing by listing_id. Sold units return status sold and price null.

tools.name: get_specs
tools.description: Official OEM spec figures from data/spec-cards.json. Pass listing_id or make and model, with optional year. Missing figures are omitted; nothing is estimated.

tools.name: recommend_machines
tools.description: Recommend fitting live inventory for a job, then verified OEM models not in stock. Read-only. Sold units are excluded. Missing specs stay unknown.
